name: touchHLE
description:
touchHLE is a high-level emulator (HLE) for early iPhone OS / iOS applications and games. Written in Rust, it allows classic touch-screen games from the iPhone's golden era (Super Monkey Ball, Flight Control) to run natively on PC.

Features:
- High-level emulation approach executing ARM binaries with high speed and low overhead
- Modern mouse and gamepad controls simulating iPhone touchscreens and accelerometers
- High-resolution rendering upscaling original mobile graphics to modern PC monitors
- Clean audio playback replicating original sound effects and music
- Compatible with classic 32-bit iPhone OS .ipa application packages
